nvitk.core.config
=================

.. py:module:: nvitk.core.config

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Environment-driven configuration for NumPy/CuPy backend preference and CUDA device.

----------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.core.config.BackendPreference

   nvitk.core.config.CoreConfig

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: BackendPreference

.. py:function:: _env_bool(name: str, default: bool = False) -> bool

   Parse ``1``/``true``/``yes``/``on`` (case-insensitive) from *name*, else *default*.


.. py:function:: _normalize_backend_preference(raw: str | None) -> BackendPreference

   Map free-form strings (``cpu``, ``gpu``, ``gpu_required``, …) to :data:`BackendPreference`.


.. py:class:: CoreConfig

   Immutable snapshot of ``NVITK_*`` settings used by :mod:`nvitk.core.backend`.

   .. attribute:: backend_preference

      ``auto`` tries GPU when available; ``numpy`` / ``cupy`` force a family;
      ``cupy_required`` raises if CuPy cannot run.

   .. attribute:: cuda_device

      Optional device index from ``NVITK_CUDA_DEVICE``.

   .. attribute:: warn_on_fallback

      When True, emit warnings if CuPy was requested but NumPy is used.


   .. py:attribute:: backend_preference
      :type:  BackendPreference
      :value: 'auto'



   .. py:attribute:: cuda_device
      :type:  int | None
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: warn_on_fallback
      :type:  bool
      :value: True



.. py:function:: load_core_config() -> CoreConfig

   Read ``NVITK_BACKEND``, ``NVITK_CUDA_DEVICE``, and ``NVITK_WARN_ON_FALLBACK``.

   :returns: Frozen configuration for the current process.
   :rtype: CoreConfig
